description: Translation schema for Salasel app. All language files must include these keys.

contents.description: Labels for content types (educational, awareness, purification)

presentations.description: Labels for presentation styles (narration, lecture, podcast, story)

categories.description: Labels for content categories (din, fitrah, nafs)

classes.description: Labels for target audience classes (kids, female, married, parents)

searchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text for search input field

filterAllOption.description: Option to show all items (no filter)

filterAdvancedLabel.description: Toggle label to reveal advanced filters

filterBookmarksLabel.description: Pill label to filter bookmarked playlists

bookmarkLabel.description: Action label on the bookmark button on the playlist detail page

continueWatchingLabel.description: Section heading for recently watched playlists strip

viewAllLabel.description: Button label to expand the full recently watched list

showLessLabel.description: Button label to collapse the recently watched list

hideLabel.description: Button label to hide the recently watched section

showLabel.description: Button label to show the recently watched section again

readMoreLabel.description: Button label to expand a truncated playlist description

readLessLabel.description: Button label to collapse an expanded playlist description

playlistsCountLabel.description: Playlist count label in recently watched header, use {n} as placeholder

playlistNotFound.description: Error message when playlist is not found

videoNotFound.description: Error message when video is not found

noVideosFound.description: Message when playlist has no videos

completedLabel.description: Badge label shown on a fully completed playlist card

downloadNoteLabel.description: Label/tooltip for the button that downloads a single video's note

downloadPlaylistNotesLabel.description: Label/tooltip for the button that downloads all notes in a playlist

noNotesLabel.description: Message shown when no notes exist for a playlist or video

watchOnYoutubeLabel.description: Label for the button/link that opens the video on YouTube

moveNotesSideLabel.description: Label/tooltip for the button that moves the notes panel to the other side

languagePickerTitle.description: Title of the first-visit language selection dialog

languagePickerDescription.description: Description text in the first-visit language selection dialog

notesLabel.description: Heading for the in-app note-taking area under the player

notesPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text for the in-app note textarea

noteSavedLabel.description: Status shown when an in-app note has been saved

noteSavingLabel.description: Status shown while an in-app note is being saved

videoUnavailableLabel.description: Message shown when a video cannot be embedded and must be watched on YouTube

feedback.description: Strings for the feedback widget (Discord webhook)

buttonLabel.description: Label/tooltip for the floating feedback button

typeLabel.description: Label for the feedback type selector

typeApp.description: Feedback type: suggest an app improvement

messageLabel.description: Label for the feedback message field

messagePlaceholder.description: Placeholder for the feedback message field

contactLabel.description: Label for the optional contact field

contactPlaceholder.description: Placeholder for the optional contact field

successMessage.description: Message shown after a successful submission

rateLimitMessage.description: Message shown when the user is rate limited (too many submissions)

closeLabel.description: Label for the modal close button

appDescription.description: Application description for SEO and metadata
